jobs.title: Software Engineer - Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Kastle builds AI agents that take on routine work inside banks and lenders. As a software engineering intern you will ship features used by real customers, pairing with full-time engineers on the product and the systems behind it.

What you'll do

  • Build and test features across our TypeScript front end and Python services
  • Help design evaluation tools that measure how well our agents perform
  • Take part in code review, planning and customer calls

What we're looking for

  • Studying computer science or a related subject, graduating in 2027 or 2028

  • Experience building software through projects, internships or open source

  • Able to spend the summer in our San Francisco office
